'''Yr'Apaly Omin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] animal keeper who worked in [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga's]] [[Otoh Gunga Zoological Research Facility|zoo]].

On the day [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] was assigned to work in the zoo, Omin showed the young Gungan round the complex. Upon arriving at the [[Opee sea killer/Legends|Opee sea killer]] aquarium, the animal keeper released some living food into the tank. When the Opee's tongue shot out for the food and touched the [[Hydrostatic bubble/Legends|hydrostatic bubble]] that surrounded the aquarium, Binks panicked and pressed the emergency button on a main control panel. This led to the deactivation of almost half of the zoo's hydrostatic fields. The Opee devoured some of the most expensive animals and escaped into the ocean.

==Behind the scenes==
Yr'Apaly Omin was first mentioned in [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 5|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 5]]'s entry on Jar Jar Binks; however, its account of Binks' actions directly conflicts with the stories told in the ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Adventures]]'' series, which instead place [[Huff Zinga]] in charge of the facility.
